create_HumanoidSeqPoseController: create a HumanoidSeqPoseController instance that loads motion poses from a numpy file path
reset_HumanoidSeqPoseController: reset the HumanoidSeqPoseController to its initial pose using a base transformation matrix
next_pose_HumanoidSeqPoseController: advance the HumanoidSeqPoseController to the next pose in the motion sequence with optional cycling
prev_pose_HumanoidSeqPoseController: move the HumanoidSeqPoseController to the previous pose in the motion sequence with optional cycling
calculate_pose_HumanoidSeqPoseController: calculate and set joint transforms for the current frame in the HumanoidSeqPoseController
